next.reason: 1985 GR4: a body group's NEXT GROUP affects the next body group, a report heading's the page heading, a page footing's the report footing. 2023 keeps all three: §2023:13.18.37.4 GR4 (body group: 'it will affect the location of the next non-dummy body group'), §2023:13.18.37.4 GR3 (report heading: 'namely the first body group when the report is not divided into pages, or the first page heading when the page heading consists only of relative lines'), §2023:13.18.37.4 GR5 (page footing affects a relative report footing). The unpaged first-body-group case is not new (error mode a): §1985:XIII.3.16.3 SR3 permits a relative NEXT GROUP in any group of a report without PAGE, the 1985 report heading table sets the final LINE-COUNTER from it, and §1985:XIII.3.10.8 body rule 4d presents the body group at 'The sum of the content of LINE-COUNTER and the integer of the first LINE NUMBER clause'. Same effect for every conforming 1985 program.
